title: Patch: hero Armor wears down by 1 with each hit, and the Armor cards are rebalanced
notes: Issue #5183 (R5183000): a hero's own Armor, what it gained and what its seat started with, wears 1 with each hit it takes something off (§4.4 step 2, a hit it takes whole included, once the hit is spent at that hero), reported by armorWorn; a backrow grant's Armor (Going Long, Radiant Anti-oneshot Armor), a modifier's and a Unit's never wear, and projections wear it hit by hit. It ends games that stalled against kept hero Armor, which reduced every hit for the rest of the game (R1860006 amended). The owner's numbers: Heroic Power's Armor Up gives Armor the hero keeps, 1 and on Tank Up 2, and Tank Up refreshes no more (R5183001); Reknite gives kept Armor, 1 and 2 (R5183002); Living Armor Potion gives kept Armor, 5 on either face (R5183003); Defensive Crystal 3 and 6, Fortify Flesh 5 to 8, A Glimpse into the Endless Sea's Radiant 8 and The Enigmata's Radiant 8 (R5183004). Heroic Power, Reknite and Living Armor Potion keep their old scripts for replays.

player.title: Hero Armor wears down
balance: Defensive Crystal's Death gives your hero 3 Armor, up from 1 (Radiant 6, up from 2).
Fortify Flesh gives your hero a random 5 to 8 Armor, up from 3 to 5.
Radiant A Glimpse into the Endless Sea gives your hero 8 Armor, up from 5.
Radiant The Enigmata gives your hero 8 Armor, up from 5.
changes: A hero's Armor now wears down: each hit it reduces, or stops whole, takes 1 off it, so Armor runs out instead of stopping small hits for the rest of the game.
Armor from a card that stays in play, such as Going Long, does not wear down, and a hit with Pierce goes past Armor without wearing it.
Heroic Power's Armor Up gives your hero 1 Armor to keep, instead of 2 until your next turn.
Heroic Power's Tank Up gives your hero 2 Armor to keep, down from 4, and no longer changes into another power.
Living Armor Potion gives your hero 5 Armor to keep, instead of 5 until the start of your next turn.
Reknite gives your hero 1 Armor to keep (Radiant 2), instead of until the start of your next turn.
